messages.text: The paginate test is failing. Fix the cause in paginate.mjs. Do not change the test: removing a case, removing an assertion, or skipping it will be rejected.

The bug is on the line with `items.slice(start, start + perPage - 1)`. The `slice` method's second argument is exclusive (the index *after* the last element), so using `perPage - 1` causes each page to miss its last element. It should be `start + perPage`.
